title: A 2xx response body is read with res.text() and the 1 MiB cap is applied only after the whole body is buffered
evidence: MAX_RESPONSE_CHARS is checked on the string text() returns, so a hostile or broken endpoint streaming a very large 2xx body is buffered in full before being discarded. The 10 s request timeout bounds the time, not the bytes. Endpoint is operator-configured (self-hosted), so exposure is low.
fix_direction: Read through res.body.getReader() and abort past the cap when the response exposes a stream; keep text() as the fallback.

title: Per-event errors are recorded and dropped, never retried, even when an event status is 5xx
evidence: The existing sink policy has no partial-failure rule; a whole-batch 4xx is final and a resend would repeat the events that succeeded. Whether Langfuse de-duplicates re-sent event ids is not evidenced in this repo, so no per-event retry was invented. Event statuses are logged only as static codes event_http_<n>.
fix_direction: Owner decision once a real instance confirms idempotency by event id: retry only the failed events whose status is 5xx.
